Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: In Step 4, the WebSurfer incorrectly stated that William Walton died in Naples, Italy. Historical fact confirms that William Walton died at his home in Kensington, London, England (specifically at 12 Kensington Park Road), not in Naples. The error likely stems from a hallucination or misinterpretation of the Wikipedia page content (which may have mentioned his time in Italy or a different William Walton), as the visible screenshot in the conversation did not show the infobox containing the correct death location.
